## What's new

- **Easier to move the notch:** open it and drag the grip in its top-left corner; the notch no longer closes while you
  drag it. Or pick **Left / Centre / Right** (and an exact position) in Settings → Notch.
- **Uninstall from the settings:** Settings → Updates and info → Uninstall NotchPC (asks first and whether to keep
  your settings).
